jobs.title: Senior Distributed Systems Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Distributed Systems Engineer to scale our global multi-region cloud infrastructure, low-latency database replication, and edge-native data streaming architectures.
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain highly resilient distributed backend services deployed across multi-cloud regions.
Optimize database throughput, caching strategies, and global state synchronization using Neon Postgres and distributed storage.
Collaborate with worldwide cross-functional product and infrastructure teams asynchronously.
Participate in high-availability on-call rotations and lead post-incident architectural reviews.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers across international hubs.
requirements: 5+ years of software engineering experience focusing on distributed backend microservices (Go, TypeScript, Rust, or Python).
Strong practical experience with PostgreSQL, replication, transaction isolation levels, and serverless database architectures.
Familiarity with containerized Kubernetes workloads, Docker, and CI/CD automation pipelines.
Demonstrated experience working in asynchronous, globally distributed engineering teams.
Excellent written communication and clear technical documentation habits.
benefits: 100% remote work flexibility from anywhere in the world
Competitive compensation with meaningful equity options
$3,500 annual home office, equipment, and co-working stipend
Unlimited paid time off with a mandatory 4-week annual minimum
Comprehensive international health, dental, and wellness coverage

applications.coverNote: Excited about high-scale distributed databases and multi-region consensus. I have spent the last 4 years architecting resilient event streams on Kafka and Postgres.
applications.resumeText: Summary: 7+ years architecting microservices, Kubernetes clusters, and low-latency databases. Led migration of 40M daily active user services to serverless PostgreSQL.

notes.author: Sarah Chen (Senior Recruiter)
notes.text: Exceptional communication during initial screen. Deep knowledge of consensus algorithms and database sharding. Recommended for tech panel.

applications.coverNote: Passionate about edge caching and serverless databases like Neon. Looking for a high-impact global team with asynchronous culture.
applications.resumeText: Experience: Senior Infra Engineer. Built automated failover across AWS us-east-1 and eu-central-1. Expert in Rust, TypeScript, and Terraform.

notes.author: Alex Thorne (Engineering Director)
notes.text: Strong technical interview round. Acceled in system design question regarding global consistency and cache invalidation.

applications.coverNote: Experienced in building globally distributed microservices and handling high concurrency with PostgreSQL connections.
applications.resumeText: Experienced in Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and distributed SQL. Built data pipeline handling 100k events/sec.
